1.topic: Verb to be: am / is / are
Verb to be: am / is / are

questions.hint: Boys is plural, so use are.

questions.prompt: Ali is a boy. ___ is kind.

questions.hint: Use you when speaking to someone.

questions.prompt: The books are new. ___ are blue.

questions.hint: A cup rests on a table.
